The unmarked van’s rear doors seal shut. The girl—collared, silent, still trembling from her final obedience test—sits on her knees. Her eyes don’t meet mine. They haven’t for days. She know their place.

The client leans against the black SUV. Custom suit, smells of money.

“She’s perfect,” he says, voice smooth with disbelief and hunger. He glances toward the van, then back at me. “I don’t know how the fuck you did it! She used to bite.”

I don’t answer. There’s nothing to explain. There is only the process.

He offers his hand—hesitates—then just nods. “Payment’s already wired. You’ll find a bonus. For… the trick you taught her to do with her throat.”

Another commission fulfilled. Another defiant flame extinguished, reshaped into something warm and obedient.

When I return to the facility, three new folders wait on my tablet screen. Just arrived. Time to pick my next commission.

— 1) CLIENT: M. Volkov – "She’s an influencer. Make her forget her audience. Make her beg to be filmed for me only."
— 2) CLIENT: K. Ishiro – "No vaginal penetration, leave her hymen intact. Train for public restraint exposure."
— 3) CLIENT: Anonymous – "No name. No background. You choose how she breaks. We want raw footage."
— 4) Request for a specific Client Commission or just others

Another round begins.

She stepped into the intake chamber like it was a joke—arms folded, designer sunglasses still on, lip gloss perfect. Long platinum hair, tight waist, no shame in her stance. A spoiled little broadcast queen used to attention, never correction.

Her phone had been confiscated. Her name meant nothing here. The silence around her wasn’t passive—it was absolute.

Concrete walls. LED lighting. Restraint points on the floor. One chair, bolted. One collar, waiting.

She rolled her eyes. “Seriously?”

No response. Only the soft click of the observation system activating.

For the first time, she looked uncertain. Not scared—yet. But aware.

The rules hadn’t been explained.
They wouldn’t be.
She would learn them.
